definitions.explanation: A small document used to record business transactions, orders, deliveries, or accounting entries. Common in retail, restaurants, and accounting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧{伝票|でんぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧。
⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{伝票|でんぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please get the slip at the register.

examples.japanese: {伝票|でんぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}して→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Organize the slips and enter them in the ledger.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{伝|でん} (transmit) + ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧ (slip, vote)

TYPES OF {伝票|でんぴょう}:
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧{伝票|でんぴょう} - sales slip
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧{伝票|でんぴょう} - purchase slip
- ⟦{入金|にゅうきん}→入金：05467_nyuukin⟧{伝票|でんぴょう} - receipt voucher
- {出金|しゅっきん}{伝票|でんぴょう} - payment voucher
- ⟦{振替|ふりかえ}→振替：15942_furikae⟧{伝票|でんぴょう} - transfer slip
- ⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧{伝票|でんぴょう} - delivery slip

RESTAURANT CONTEXT:
In restaurants, {伝票|でんぴょう} (also called "⟦お{会計|かいけい}→お会計：09550_okaikei⟧」) is the bill/check that the customer receives.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {伝票|でんぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ - to write up a slip
- {伝票|でんぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ - to pass along a slip
- {伝票|でんぴょう}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ - slip processing

ACCOUNTING USE:
In bookkeeping, {伝票|でんぴょう} serves as the source document for recording transactions in the ⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧ (ledger).
